name: chart_of_accounts_permissions
preconditionSql:
SELECT
 (SELECT version FROM public.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)='0035'
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.permissions
     WHERE permission_key IN ('accounting.chart.view','accounting.chart.manage','accounting.mappings.view','accounting.mappings.manage')
        OR id IN ('09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101'::uuid,'09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000102'::uuid,'09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103'::uuid,'09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000104'::uuid))
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.roles
     WHERE (role_key='SYSTEM_ADMIN'
          AND (is_system IS DISTINCT FROM true OR display_name_key<>'roles.systemAdmin'))
        OR (role_key='ACCOUNTANT'
          AND (is_system IS DISTINCT FROM true OR display_name_key<>'roles.accountant')))
 AS ok;
verificationSql:
WITH expected_permissions(id,permission_key,module,description_key) AS (VALUES
  ('09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101'::uuid,'accounting.chart.view','accounting','permissions.accounting.chart.view'),
  ('09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000102'::uuid,'accounting.chart.manage','accounting','permissions.accounting.chart.manage'),
  ('09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103'::uuid,'accounting.mappings.view','accounting','permissions.accounting.mappings.view'),
  ('09080000-0000-4000-8000-000000000104'::uuid,'accounting.mappings.manage','accounting','permissions.accounting.mappings.manage')
),
expected_grants(role_key,permission_key) AS (VALUES
  ('SYSTEM_ADMIN','accounting.chart.view'),
  ('SYSTEM_ADMIN','accounting.chart.manage'),
  ('SYSTEM_ADMIN','accounting.mappings.view'),
  ('SYSTEM_ADMIN','accounting.mappings.manage'),
  ('ACCOUNTANT','accounting.chart.view'),
  ('ACCOUNTANT','accounting.mappings.view')
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.permissions p
   JOIN expected_permissions e ON p.id=e.id AND p.permission_key=e.permission_key
    AND p.module=e.module AND p.description_key=e.description_key)=4
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.permissions p
       WHERE p.permission_key IN ('accounting.chart.view','accounting.chart.manage','accounting.mappings.view','accounting.mappings.manage'))=4
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.role_permissions rp
    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id=rp.permission_id
    JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=rp.role_id
    WHERE p.permission_key IN ('accounting.chart.view','accounting.chart.manage','accounting.mappings.view','accounting.mappings.manage')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expected_grants g
       WHERE g.role_key=r.role_key AND g.permission_key=p.permission_key
         AND rp.is_allowed=true)
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM expected_grants g
    JOIN public.roles r ON r.role_key=g.role_key
    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.permission_key=g.permission_key
    LEFT JOIN public.role_permissions rp
      ON rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.permission_id=p.id
    WHERE rp.is_allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true
  ) AS ok;
recovery: The PostgreSQL migration is atomic. A failed role-catalog integrity precondition or permission-key/UUID conflict aborts BEFORE any write; SQL or COMMIT failures roll back all four permissions and grants and do not record 0036. Do not overwrite existing keys, role grants, user overrides or migration checksums. For pre-existing unexpected SYSTEM_ADMIN/ACCOUNTANT metadata run an audited RoleCatalog repair in a separate authorized operation, rerun preflight, and apply the unchanged 0036. After a successful 0036, any correction must be a NEW forward-only migration; do not run on Production without independent backup/change approval.
